properties.SQL Statement:
INSERT INTO parciales_moodle 
(user_id, course_id, cant_disc_creadas, cant_posts, cant_revisiones, cant_contenido_visto)
VALUES (${user_id}, ${course_id}, ${cant_disc_creadas}, ${cant_posts}, ${cant_revisiones}, ${cant_contenido_visto})
ON CONFLICT (user_id, course_id) 
DO UPDATE SET 
    cant_disc_creadas = parciales_moodle.cant_disc_creadas + EXCLUDED.cant_disc_creadas,
    cant_posts = parciales_moodle.cant_posts + EXCLUDED.cant_posts,
    cant_revisiones = parciales_moodle.cant_revisiones + EXCLUDED.cant_revisiones,
    cant_contenido_visto = parciales_moodle.cant_contenido_visto + EXCLUDED.cant_contenido_visto,
    actualizado = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

properties.Attributes List: course_id, user_id, user_name, event_name, timestamp, action

properties.metricas:
SELECT
  user_id,
  course_id,

  SUM(CASE 
        WHEN event_name = 'discussion_created'
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
      END) AS cant_disc_creadas,

  SUM(CASE 
        WHEN event_name = 'post_created'
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
      END) AS cant_posts,

  SUM(CASE 
        WHEN event_name IN (
          'attempt_reviewed',
          'submission_viewed',
          'response_viewed'
        )
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
      END) AS cant_revisiones,

  SUM(CASE 
        WHEN event_name = 'course_module_viewed'
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
      END) AS cant_contenido_visto

FROM FLOWFILE
WHERE
  user_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  user_id,
  course_id

properties.union:
SELECT 
    t1.user_id AS id_usuario, 
    t1.course_id AS id_curso,
    t1.nota_final AS nota_promedio,
    t1.actividades_hechas AS cant_acts_hechas,
    t1.actividades_totales AS cant_acts_totales,

    COALESCE(t2.cant_disc_creadas, 0) AS cant_discs_creadas,
    COALESCE(t2.cant_posts, 0) AS cant_mensajes,
    COALESCE(t2.cant_contenido_visto, 0) AS cant_cont_visto,

    t1.encuestas_respondidas AS cant_encuestas_resp,
    t1.total_encuestas AS cant_encs_totales,

    COALESCE(t2.cant_revisiones, 0) AS cant_revisiones,

    '${now():format("yyyyMMdd")}' AS id_tiempo

FROM FLOWFILE t1

LEFT JOIN FLOWFILE t2 
  ON t1.user_id = t2.user_id 
  AND t1.course_id = t2.course_id
  AND t2.tipo = 'parciales'
WHERE t1.tipo = 'union'

SELECT 
    CAST(a.user_id AS VARCHAR) AS user_id, 
    CAST(a.course_id AS VARCHAR) AS course_id,
    a.nota_final,
    a.actividades_hechas,
    a.actividades_totales,
    e.total_encuestas,
    e.encuestas_respondidas,
    'union' AS tipo
FROM FLOWFILE a
JOIN FLOWFILE e 
    ON CAST(a.user_id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(e.user_id AS VARCHAR)
    AND CAST(a.course_id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(e.course_id AS VARCHAR)
WHERE a.tipo = 'actividades' 
  AND e.tipo = 'encuestas'

properties.discord:
SELECT 
    u.id_usuario,
    c.id_curso,
    p.cant_mensajes,
    p.cant_encuestas,
    p.tiempo_voz,
    p.cant_disc_creadas AS cant_discs_creadas,
    p.cant_reacciones, 
    '${now():format("yyyyMMdd")}' AS id_tiempo
FROM FLOWFILE p
JOIN FLOWFILE u ON CAST(p.discord_id AS VARCHAR) = u.discord_id
JOIN FLOWFILE c ON CAST(p.id_servidor AS VARCHAR) = c.id_servidor_ds
WHERE p.tipo = 'discord' 
  AND u.tipo = 'usuario' 
  AND c.tipo = 'curso'

properties.participantes:
SELECT
  '${user_id}' AS id_usuario,
  '${meeting_id}' AS id_sesion_ext, 
  '${course_id}' AS id_curso,
  '${internal_meeting_id}' AS id_sesion_interna,
  CAST(
    SUBSTRING('${start}', 1, 4) || 
    SUBSTRING('${start}', 6, 2) || 
    SUBSTRING('${start}', 9, 2) 
  AS INT) AS id_tiempo,

   CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTRING('${start}', 1, 19), 'T', ' ') AS TIMESTAMP) AS inicio,
  CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTRING('${finish}', 1, 19), 'T', ' ') AS TIMESTAMP) AS fin,

  CAST('${meeting_duration}' AS INT) AS tiempo_sesion,
  '${meeting_duration}' AS duracion_sesion,
  duration AS duracion_usuario,

  CAST('${messages}' AS INT) AS cant_mensajes,
  CAST('${talk_time}' AS INT) AS tiempo_voz,
  CAST('${handraise}' AS INT) AS cant_manos_levantadas,
  CAST('${reactions}' AS INT) AS cant_reacciones,
  CAST('${polls}' AS INT) AS cant_encuestas,
  'participante' AS tipo
FROM FLOWFILE

SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN metrica = 'Encuestas' THEN valor END) AS encuestas,
    MAX(CASE WHEN metrica = 'Mensajes' THEN valor END) AS mensajes,
    MAX(CASE WHEN metrica = 'Manos levantadas' THEN valor END) AS manos_lev,
    MAX(CASE WHEN metrica = 'Reacciones' THEN valor END) AS reacciones,
    MAX(CASE WHEN metrica = 'Tiempo de micrófono activo' THEN valor END) AS tiempo_voz,
    MAX(CASE WHEN metrica = 'Duración en sesión' THEN valor END) AS duracion_usuario
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.id_metrica)
        m.id_metrica,
        m.nombre AS metrica,
        pond.valor
    FROM metricas AS m
    INNER JOIN plataformas AS plat ON m.id_plataforma = plat.id_plataforma
    INNER JOIN ponderaciones AS pond ON m.id_metrica = pond.id_metrica
    WHERE plat.nombre = 'Bigbluebutton' 
      AND (pond.id_curso = ${id_curso} OR pond.id_curso = -1)
    ORDER BY 
        m.id_metrica, 
        -- Prioridad: 1 para el curso específico, 2 para el global (-1)
        CASE WHEN pond.id_curso = ${id_curso} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC,
        pond.actualizado DESC
) AS subquery;

SELECT 
    base.id_usuario,
    base.id_curso,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(
            (CASE WHEN ts.total_mensajes = 0 THEN 0 ELSE u.cant_mensajes * 1.0 / ts.total_mensajes END) * ${mensajes} +
            (CASE WHEN ts.total_reacciones = 0 THEN 0 ELSE u.cant_reacciones * 1.0 / ts.total_reacciones END) * ${reacciones} +
            (CASE WHEN ts.total_encuestas = 0 THEN 0 ELSE u.cant_encuestas * 1.0 / ts.total_encuestas END) * ${encuestas} +
            (CASE WHEN ts.total_ml = 0 THEN 0 ELSE u.cant_ml * 1.0 / ts.total_ml END) * ${manos_lev} +
            (CASE WHEN ts.total_tiempo_voz = 0 THEN 0 ELSE u.tiempo_voz * 1.0 / ts.total_tiempo_voz END) * ${tiempo_voz} +
            (CASE WHEN ts.total_duracion_u = 0 THEN 0 ELSE u.duracion_usuario * 1.0 / ts.total_duracion_u END) * ${duracion_usuario}
        , 0)
    , 3) AS eng_bbb, ${valor} AS b_valor,
    'bbb' AS tipo

FROM (
    -- Filtramos el curso 1 en la base para que BBB no emita FlowFiles de ese ID
    SELECT DISTINCT id_usuario, id_curso 
    FROM fact_moodle 
    WHERE id_curso = ${id_curso} AND id_curso != 1
) AS base

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT  
        id_usuario,
        SUM(cant_mensajes) AS cant_mensajes,
        SUM(cant_reacciones) AS cant_reacciones,
        SUM(cant_encuestas) AS cant_encuestas,
        SUM(cant_manos_levantadas) AS cant_ml,
        SUM(tiempo_voz) AS tiempo_voz,
        SUM(duracion_usuario) AS duracion_usuario
    FROM fact_bbb
    WHERE id_curso = ${id_curso}
    GROUP BY id_usuario
) AS u ON base.id_usuario = u.id_usuario

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        id_curso,
        SUM(cant_mensajes) as total_mensajes,
        SUM(cant_reacciones) as total_reacciones,
        SUM(cant_encuestas) as total_encuestas,
        SUM(cant_manos_levantadas) as total_ml,
        SUM(tiempo_voz) as total_tiempo_voz,
        SUM(duracion_usuario) as total_duracion_u
    FROM fact_bbb
    WHERE id_curso = ${id_curso}
    GROUP BY id_curso
) AS ts ON base.id_curso = ts.id_curso;

SELECT 
    u.id_usuario AS id_usuario,
    u.id_curso AS id_curso,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE((CASE WHEN t.total_mensajes = 0 THEN 0 ELSE u.cant_mensajes * 1.0 / t.total_mensajes END) * ${mensajes}, 0) +
        COALESCE((CASE WHEN t.total_visto = 0 THEN 0 ELSE u.cant_cont_visto * 1.0 / t.total_visto END) * ${cont_visto}, 0) +
        COALESCE((CASE WHEN t.total_revisiones = 0 THEN 0 ELSE u.cant_revisiones * 1.0 / t.total_visto END) * ${cont_visto}, 0) +
        COALESCE((CASE WHEN t.total_encuestas = 0 THEN 0 ELSE u.cant_encuestas_resp * 1.0 / t.total_encuestas END) * ${encuestas}, 0) +
        COALESCE((CASE WHEN t.cant_acts_totales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE u.cant_acts_hechas * 1.0 / t.cant_acts_totales END) * ${actividades}, 0) +
        COALESCE((CASE WHEN t.total_discusiones = 0 THEN 0 ELSE u.cant_discs_creadas * 1.0 / t.total_discusiones END) * ${discusiones}, 0), 
        3
    ) AS eng_moodle, ${valor} AS m_valor,
    u.nota_promedio,
    u.tipo AS tipo
FROM (
    SELECT 
        id_usuario,
        id_curso,
        cant_mensajes,
        cant_cont_visto,
        cant_revisiones,
        cant_encuestas_resp,
        cant_acts_hechas,
        nota_promedio,
        cant_discs_creadas,
        'moodle' AS tipo
    FROM fact_moodle
    WHERE id_tiempo = (SELECT MAX(id_tiempo) FROM fact_moodle)
      AND id_curso = ${id_curso} 
      AND id_curso != 1
) AS u
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        id_curso,
        NULLIF(SUM(cant_mensajes), 0) AS total_mensajes,
        NULLIF(MAX(cant_acts_totales), 0) AS cant_acts_totales,
        NULLIF(SUM(cant_cont_visto), 0) AS total_visto,
        NULLIF(SUM(cant_discs_creadas), 0) AS total_discusiones,
        NULLIF(SUM(cant_revisiones), 0) AS total_revisiones,
        NULLIF(SUM(cant_encs_totales), 0) AS total_encuestas
    FROM fact_moodle
    WHERE id_curso = ${id_curso} 
      AND id_curso != 1
    GROUP BY id_curso
) AS t ON u.id_curso = t.id_curso;

properties.fact_engagement:
SELECT 
    CAST(m.id_usuario AS INT) AS id_usuario,
    CAST(m.id_curso AS INT) AS id_curso,
    CAST('${now():format("yyyyMMdd")}' AS INT) AS id_tiempo,
    CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(CAST(m.eng_moodle AS DOUBLE), 0) * 100, 3) AS DOUBLE) AS eng_moodle,
    CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(CAST(b.eng_bbb AS DOUBLE), 0) * 100, 3) AS DOUBLE) AS eng_bbb,
    CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(CAST(d.eng_discord AS DOUBLE), 0) * 100, 3) AS DOUBLE) AS eng_discord,
    CAST(ROUND(
        (
            COALESCE(CAST(m.eng_moodle AS DOUBLE), 0) * m.m_valor +
            COALESCE(CAST(b.eng_bbb AS DOUBLE), 0) * b.b_valor +
            COALESCE(CAST(d.eng_discord AS DOUBLE) * d.d_valor, 0)
        ) * 100, 
    3) AS DOUBLE) AS eng_general,
    CAST(ROUND(CAST(m.nota_promedio AS DOUBLE), 3) AS DOUBLE) AS nota_promedio
FROM FLOWFILE m
LEFT JOIN FLOWFILE b 
    ON m.id_usuario = b.id_usuario 
    AND m.id_curso = b.id_curso
    AND b.tipo = 'bbb'
LEFT JOIN FLOWFILE d 
    ON m.id_usuario = d.id_usuario 
    AND m.id_curso = d.id_curso 
    AND d.tipo = 'discord'
WHERE m.tipo = 'moodle'
